messages:
Tess (CS): Quick FYI — launching a small beta concierge for 8 seats next week. Objectives: reduce initial setup friction, capture enablement gaps, and flag any renewal-risk signals during onboarding. Who can help run sessions + triage issues?
Gabe (PM): I can run two sessions Wed/Thu 11am PT. Want to measure time-to-first-success and surface any infra blockers. Can Priya join for live troubleshooting?
Priya (SE): Yep, I can take Wed 11. I will bring the minimal install checklist and an SSO troubleshooting snippet. Link to the internal runbook: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/onboard-beta
Omar (CS): I'll handle invites and the post-call survey. Proposed micro-survey = 5 Qs (time to complete, clarity, blockers, LTR 1-5, deal-breaker?). I'll draft it now.
Gabe (PM): Please include a single-choice "deal-breaker: yes/no" and a free-text field for infra concerns. Tag P0 if yes.
Priya (SE): For Okta + SCIM: remind customers to set `provisioning.scim.enabled=true` and for restricted registries set `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` in helm. Paste snippet: `provisioning:\n  scim:\n    enabled: true`
Tess (CS): EvalBot — can you generate calendar invites for Wed/Thu 11 and attach the survey?
EvalBot: Calendar events created: Beta Concierge — Wed 2025-07-09 11:00 PT & Thu 2025-07-10 11:00 PT. Survey link attached: https://forms.redwood.com/beta-concierge-2025. Attendees: Tess, Gabe, Priya, Omar.
Omar (CS): Post-call plan: 1) send Loom recap within 24h, 2) push micro-survey, 3) compile top-3 friction items and assign owners (quick wins vs backlog). I'll own the follow-ups.
Gabe (PM): We'll capture an "activation confidence" score (1-5). Anything under 3 -> tag as renewal-risk and schedule a follow-up within 3 business days.
Tess (CS): Great. If anyone else wants to observe live Qs for enablement notes, ping me. I'll post the cohort roster + invite in ~20m. :white_check_mark:
